title: Unequal-Mass 4-Corner Mixture (2% Rare Mode) (Published Prior Cohort)
intuition: Published-prior cohort variant of `vector_unequal_mass` with explicit `learnable=True` MoG prior declaration, testing transfer consistency across minor prior-contract differences. Four corner Gaussians with highly skewed weights [55%, 30%, 13%, 2%]. Tests whether the trainer preserves both the exact share (min_mass_ratio >= 0.25, mass_tv <= 0.15) and local covariance of a rare 2% cluster.
failure_mode: Rare clusters receive sparse minibatch signal and get either absorbed into major modes, over-equalized (destroying mass_tv), or flattened into degenerate 1D lines.
protocol_notes: Separate published transfer cohort of `vector_unequal_mass`; historical sensitivity observed across architectures.
